# shadcn-egui-core

Data types shared by [shadcn-egui](https://crates.io/crates/shadcn-egui), the
shadcn/ui design system for egui, and its font and icon crates: icon shapes
and slots, font files and font sources.

You do not depend on this crate directly: `shadcn-egui` re-exports
everything in it.
